title: Run-time seed selection and per-run analysis tab
approval_note: Approved by the user on 2026-10-07 (PLAN.md 2.5): interactive Chart.js charts with per-chart PNG download and a bulk download of all charts, both the corrected scores and the legacy composite score, CSV export.
purpose: Let the user choose the seed when starting a run, and give every finished run an analysis page with the charts of the legacy analysis script plus learning diagnostics, score tables and CSV export, all computed from the database.

modify: abmem/views.py (run_simulation: accept a seed; simulation_list context)

public_interfaces.signature: run_simulation(request, simulation_id): POST with optional 'seed' (form field or JSON)
public_interfaces.description: Validates seed in [0, 2**31) (views.SEED_UPPER_BOUND), passes it to library_service.clone_scenario_for_run(seed=...). Missing seed keeps the scenario seed. Invalid seed -> HTTP 400 JSON error, no run created. GET keeps working for existing links (scenario seed).

Pure read-only aggregation from the DB with a bounded number of queries (select_related/prefetch_related). Returns dataclasses: run settings (seed, lags, evaluation_periods, strategy, bounds, periodNumber, agent algorithm/fail-stack), period series (periodNumber, demand, metDemand, ptf, marketVolume), per-offer rows (period, agent, plant/resource, amount, offerPrice, accepted, acceptanceAmount, acceptancePrice), budget series per agent reconstructed from offer profits (accounting.offer_profit) starting at the true initial budget, step-log series per agent (reward, critic_loss, actor_loss, mean_q, exploration scale, intervened, learning_active), agent summary (initial/final budget, budget change, mean budget change per period, acceptance rate, mean offer price, mean accepted offer price, accepted energy, revenue, profit, per-resource breakdown with the same columns), corrected scores from abmem.services.hpo.objective over the whole run and over the evaluation window if evaluation_periods > 0, legacy scores from legacy_scores.py. Raises a clear error if the run is not FINISHED or has no periods (e.g. purged HPO trials).

Exact port of abc_log/try/sim/compute_advanced_scores.py (price_cap = 200, capacity = first offer amount, initial budget = first row budget, 0.4/0.4/0.2 agent score clipped to [0, 1], market score 0.6*(1 - MCP/200) + 0.4*MCP/mean offer price), without prints. Docstring states it is the archived pre-B9 definition kept for comparison (docs/legacy_rewards.md).

public_interfaces.signature: def periods_csv(sim) -> str; def offers_csv(sim) -> str; def step_logs_csv(sim) -> str
public_interfaces.description: UTF-8 CSV with a header row, decimal point '.', one row per period / offer / step-log row, stable column order documented in the docstring.

public_interfaces.signature: simulation_analysis(request, sim_id); simulation_analysis_data(request, sim_id) -> JsonResponse; simulation_export_csv(request, sim_id, kind)
public_interfaces.description: Routes: simulation/<id>/analysis/ (page), simulation/<id>/analysis/data/ (JSON for the charts and tables), simulation/<id>/export/<kind>.csv with kind in {periods, offers, steps} (Content-Disposition attachment, filename simulation_<id>_<kind>.csv). 404 for unknown simulation, 409 with a message for runs that are not FINISHED or have no data. Proxy scenarios have no analysis.

ui_contract.charts: Chart.js already bundled (abmem/static/assets/js/plugins/chartjs.min.js). Charts: (1) PTF, demand and met demand per period; (2) all offers per period, accepted vs rejected, with the PTF line; (3) budget per agent per period; (4) agent panel with an agent selector: offers per plant/resource, accepted vs rejected, PTF line, acceptance rate; (5) learning diagnostics per agent: reward, critic and actor loss, mean Q, exploration scale, fail-stack interventions as markers, evaluation window shaded; (6) scores: corrected agent score and market score, legacy composite agent scores and legacy market score, clearly labelled. Legends toggle series. Each chart has a 'PNG' button (chart.toBase64Image). A page-level 'Download all charts' button builds one ZIP with all chart PNGs client-side using abmem/static/assets/js/zip-store.js, a small dependency-free ZIP writer (stored entries, CRC-32) written for this project. No external downloads or CDN libraries.
ui_contract.tables: Run settings, agent summary with expandable per-resource rows, period table, offers table with agent and period filters (client-side pagination). CSV buttons for periods, offers and step logs.
ui_contract.navigation: Analysis button on the watch page when the run is FINISHED and in the run list. Seed shown on the watch page and as a column in the run list. Run dialog on the scenario (templates) list with a seed field prefilled with the scenario seed and a 'random seed' button; no blocking browser dialogs (use a Bootstrap modal).

invariants: Analysis is read-only: no writes to the database.
Budget series reconstructed from offer profits ends at the stored final Agent.budget (within 0.01).
Corrected scores equal the values hpo.objective computes for the same run.
Legacy scores reproduce compute_advanced_scores.py on the same data.
edge_cases: Run not FINISHED, run with zero periods (purged HPO trial), run with one period, agent with no accepted offer, evaluation_periods = 0, step logs missing for baseline agents, multi-plant agents, seed 0 and 2**31 - 1, seed out of range or non-integer.
test_plan: Analysis aggregates on a small run created with the existing runtime test helpers (tests/runtime/conftest.py, tests/factories.py): summary values against hand-computed numbers, budget series end equals Agent.budget, corrected scores equal hpo.objective, legacy scores equal a direct reimplementation on the same rows.
CSV: header and row counts, round trip with the csv module.
Views: page and data endpoint 200 for a finished run, 409 for unfinished/purged, 404 unknown, CSV content type and filename.
Run seed: POST with seed creates a run with that seed and leaves the scenario seed unchanged, invalid seed -> 400 and no run, GET still works.
node --check on the rendered inline scripts and on zip-store.js; a JS-free Python test that builds the same ZIP layout is not required.
